properties.site-address: Former Parker Hannifin Site, Walkmill Lane, Cannock
properties.notes: CH/15/0080 is outline planning application for the erection of up to 93 dwellings, refused May 2016 primarily on the grounds of no affordable housing provision- under appeal. The site has since been purchased by the Homes and Communities Agency who are pursuing residential development of the site, including affordable housing provision. Site has contamination issues from industrial legacy.
